exp-1.description: Led migration of legacy systems (.NET Framework) to Angular + .NET Core 7 using reverse engineering on compiled binaries. Optimized critical reports reducing load times from 10 min to 1 min (-90%). Implemented CI/CD pipeline with Azure DevOps, Docker and Azure Container Apps. Designed federated authentication with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

exp-2.description: Designed the merchant Onboarding system, reducing registration time from 2 hours to 15 minutes (-87%). Led migration of Facilito Web to Angular + .NET 6, achieving a 30% faster system. Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployments from 1 hour to 10 minutes. Integrated CISLATAM services (Western Union).

exp-3.description: Taught mobile development course with Ionic and Angular at higher education level, with hands-on approach based on real projects. Guided the construction of CRUD applications consuming REST APIs and performed personalized code reviews.

exp-4.description: Developed the credit application and member enrollment system. Built the institutional mobile app reducing member enrollment from 3-4 hours to 20 minutes. Implemented the web and mobile credit approval module, reducing processing from 6 hours to 1 hour.

exp-5.description: Participated in developing the TendaGo mobile app in Flutter and the Service Broker web admin. Designed mobile interface prototypes in Figma for client presentations.
